name: lookup-resolve
description:
One resolver behind the quote form's `lookup` inputs, branched on `kind`,
serving all five kinds in contract artefact 7 §3 over one gateway path
(POST /antipodean/lookup, non-public).

| kind | hop | resolves against |
|---|---|---|
| address | search | Google Places Autocomplete |
| address_details | details | Google Place Details, fields=address_components,formatted_address |
| abn | search | ABR MatchingNames.aspx (JSONP) |
| abn_details | details | ABR AbnDetails.aspx (JSONP) |
| occupation | search | occupation_config records - NOT an external API |

Adding a kind is an edit to contract 7's table and to PREPARE/ROUTE/RESPOND
here, not a new flow and not a new mapping.

Spend is bounded in PREPARE, never by the gateway: cerberus's Limit.Time is
ms x time.Second and its key is global. PREPARE reads a fixed allowlist of eight
trigger keys, rejects an unknown kind, holds a search under 3 characters back
from calling out at all, caps limit at 50, and requires a details hop to carry a
value.

config.result is "$.RESPOND" - the gateway projects the terminal node's return
value, not the run result, so a payload a secret reference was substituted
into never reaches the browser.

Response is contract 7 §2: {options:[{value,text,note,...}], total, count,
has_more, next_offset} for a search, {option:{...}} for a details hop, {error}
for a failure. Prefill keys sit FLAT on each row because
lookup.utils.readRowKey looks a key up flat before it looks it up as a path.
